firefighter = a person whose job is to stop fires
nurse = a person who looks after patients in hospital
mechanic = a person who repairs cars or machines
shop assistant = a person who helps customers in a shop
waiter = a person who brings food to tables in a restaurant
journalist = a person who writes news for papers or websites
engineer = a person who designs machines, roads or software
lawyer = a person who advises people about the law
chef = a skilled cook who runs a restaurant kitchen
plumber = a person who repairs water pipes and taps
police officer = a person whose job is to make sure people follow the law
programmer = a person who writes computer programs
apply for = to formally ask for a job
interview = a meeting where you answer questions about a job
CV = a document with your education and work history
salary = money you receive every month for your job
unemployed = without a paid job
part-time = working fewer hours than a full week
full-time = working the complete normal number of hours
overtime = extra hours after normal work time
